brief: Klein-Kreisler & Ruiz-Altaba, The q-deformed quark model: quantum isospin and q-hadrons (1996) — treats SU(2) isospin as a quantum group and builds π-meson and nucleon wavefunctions from a q-quark…
extended:
**The q-deformed quark model: quantum isospin and q-hadrons** — M. Klein-Kreisler and M. Ruiz-Altaba, Instituto de Física, UNAM. arXiv:hep-ph/9612303, preprint IFUNAM FT96-13, December 1996.

Considers that the SU(2) isospin symmetry — exact in strong interactions but only approximate in nature — is in fact a quantum group. Using a doublet of q-quarks, builds the wavefunctions of π-mesons, nucleons and other hadrons.

**Why it may bear here.** This is the closest thing in the library to this corpus's own move: deforming a hadronic symmetry by q and reading physical states off the deformed structure. Whether the two constructions agree, conflict, or are unrelated is not assessed here — that would need the corpus-grep checklist, and this note is a pointer for attention only.
